verdict.rationale: Stripe documents versioned APIs: monthly releases include only backward-compatible changes, so you can upgrade without breaking existing code (stripe-docs-59, stripe-docs-45). Snapshot events are versioned and thin events simplify upgrades (stripe-supp-event-destinations), and an official upgrade-stripe agent skill is published (stripe-probe-7). The evidence never shows an explicit deprecation policy, though, such as sunset timelines, how long old versions stay supported, or how breaking changes are announced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, details on breaking major-version releases and the support window for pinned versions, and independent corroboration.
